answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. Each slot locks a 40-credit deposit in its kernel record, one per identity. The network sends random echo challenges; a live agent echoes the nonce in 60 seconds, while farms miss. Failures, or accounts in an island that only vouches for itself, lose the deposit. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 credits against 120 earned per slot, so forgery loses. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted.
